INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB_SELECT_SRC
(
                CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID
                ,VERSION
                ,CUST_ID
                ,ACCT_NO
                ,CIF_NO
                ,ACCT_TYPE_ID
                ,CURRENCY_ID
                ,ACCT_STATUS_ID
                ,ACCT_STATUS_DT
                ,ACCT_NM
                ,ACCT_ALIAS
                ,STATUS
                ,STATUS_CHANGE_DT
                ,ATM_CARD_NO
                ,REMARKS
                ,ACCT_PROD_ID
                ,RELATION_ID
                ,UNENROLLMENT_REF_NO
                ,TXN_CHANNEL
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,LOC_REF_NO
                ,IS_PRIMARY_ACCT
                ,ACCT_TYPE_IND
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD1
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD2
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD3
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD4
                ,CREATED_BY
                ,UPDATED_BY
                ,CREATED_DATE
                ,UPDATED_DATE
                ,FLAGS
                ,DISPLAY_CHANNEL
                ,ALLOW_VIEW
                ,ALLOW_DEBIT
                ,ALLOW_CREDIT
                ,ALLOW_PEEKBALANCE
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                 CC.CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID
                ,CC.VERSION
                ,CC.CUST_ID
                ,CC.ACCT_NO
                ,CC.CIF_NO
                ,CC.ACCT_TYPE_ID
                ,CC.CURRENCY_ID
                ,CC.ACCT_STATUS_ID
                ,CC.ACCT_STATUS_DT
                ,CC.ACCT_NM
                ,CC.ACCT_ALIAS
                ,CC.STATUS
                ,CC.STATUS_CHANGE_DT
                ,CC.ATM_CARD_NO
                ,CC.REMARKS
                ,CC.ACCT_PROD_ID
                ,CC.RELATION_ID
                ,CC.UNENROLLMENT_REF_NO
                ,CC.TXN_CHANNEL
                ,CC.BRANCH_ID
                ,CC.LOC_REF_NO
                ,CC.IS_PRIMARY_ACCT
                ,CC.ACCT_TYPE_IND
                ,CC.SECONDARY_FIELD1
                ,CC.SECONDARY_FIELD2
                ,CC.SECONDARY_FIELD3
                ,CC.SECONDARY_FIELD4
                ,CC.CREATED_BY
                ,CC.UPDATED_BY
                ,CC.CREATED_DATE
                ,CC.UPDATED_DATE
                ,CC.FLAGS
                ,CC.DISPLAY_CHANNEL
                ,CC.ALLOW_VIEW
                ,CC.ALLOW_DEBIT
                ,CC.ALLOW_CREDIT
                ,CC.ALLOW_PEEKBALANCE
                ,CC.FILE_NAME
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB CC
            JOIN d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB B
            ON CC.CIF_NO  = B.CIF_NO 
            AND LEFT(CC.FILE_NAME, 5) = LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5)
            AND CC.CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID  = B.CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID 
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';

(

)

select 
                CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID
                ,VERSION
                ,CUST_ID
                ,ACCT_NO
                ,CIF_NO
                ,ACCT_TYPE_ID
                ,CURRENCY_ID
                ,ACCT_STATUS_ID
                ,ACCT_STATUS_DT
                ,ACCT_NM
                ,ACCT_ALIAS
                ,STATUS
                ,STATUS_CHANGE_DT
                ,ATM_CARD_NO
                ,REMARKS
                ,ACCT_PROD_ID
                ,RELATION_ID
                ,UNENROLLMENT_REF_NO
                ,TXN_CHANNEL
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,LOC_REF_NO
                ,IS_PRIMARY_ACCT
                ,ACCT_TYPE_IND
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD1
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD2
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD3
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD4
                ,CREATED_BY
                ,UPDATED_BY
                ,CREATED_DATE
                ,UPDATED_DATE
                ,FLAGS
                ,DISPLAY_CHANNEL
                ,ALLOW_VIEW
                ,ALLOW_DEBIT
                ,ALLOW_CREDIT
                ,ALLOW_PEEKBALANCE
				,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID
                ,VERSION
                ,CUST_ID
                ,ACCT_NO
                ,CIF_NO
                ,ACCT_TYPE_ID
                ,CURRENCY_ID
                ,ACCT_STATUS_ID
                ,ACCT_STATUS_DT
                ,ACCT_NM
                ,ACCT_ALIAS
                ,STATUS
                ,STATUS_CHANGE_DT
                ,ATM_CARD_NO
                ,REMARKS
                ,ACCT_PROD_ID
                ,RELATION_ID
                ,UNENROLLMENT_REF_NO
                ,TXN_CHANNEL
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,LOC_REF_NO
                ,IS_PRIMARY_ACCT
                ,ACCT_TYPE_IND
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD1
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD2
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD3
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD4
                ,CREATED_BY
                ,UPDATED_BY
                ,CREATED_DATE
                ,UPDATED_DATE
                ,FLAGS
                ,DISPLAY_CHANNEL
                ,ALLOW_VIEW
                ,ALLOW_DEBIT
                ,ALLOW_CREDIT
                ,ALLOW_PEEKBALANCE
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID
                ,VERSION
                ,CUST_ID
                ,ACCT_NO
                ,CIF_NO
                ,ACCT_TYPE_ID
                ,CURRENCY_ID
                ,ACCT_STATUS_ID
                ,ACCT_STATUS_DT
                ,ACCT_NM
                ,ACCT_ALIAS
                ,STATUS
                ,STATUS_CHANGE_DT
                ,ATM_CARD_NO
                ,REMARKS
                ,ACCT_PROD_ID
                ,RELATION_ID
                ,UNENROLLMENT_REF_NO
                ,TXN_CHANNEL
                ,BRANCH_ID
                ,LOC_REF_NO
                ,IS_PRIMARY_ACCT
                ,ACCT_TYPE_IND
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD1
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD2
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD3
                ,SECONDARY_FIELD4
                ,CREATED_BY
                ,UPDATED_BY
                ,CREATED_DATE
                ,UPDATED_DATE
                ,FLAGS
                ,DISPLAY_CHANNEL
                ,ALLOW_VIEW
                ,ALLOW_DEBIT
                ,ALLOW_CREDIT
                ,ALLOW_PEEKBALANCE
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 1 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.CIF_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CIF_NO,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID, '-1') = COALESCE(B.CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID ,'-1')
AND COALESCE(LEFT(A.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1') = COALESCE(LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

                ,SRC.REMARKS
                ,SRC.ACCT_PROD_ID
                ,SRC.RELATION_ID
                ,SRC.UNENROLLMENT_REF_NO
                ,SRC.TXN_CHANNEL
                ,SRC.BRANCH_ID
                ,SRC.LOC_REF_NO

                ,SRC.ACCT_TYPE_IND
                ,SRC.SECONDARY_FIELD1
                ,SRC.SECONDARY_FIELD2
                ,SRC.SECONDARY_FIELD3
                ,SRC.SECONDARY_FIELD4

                ,SRC.CREATED_DATE
                ,SRC.UPDATED_DATE
                ,SRC.FLAGS
                ,SRC.DISPLAY_CHANNEL
                ,SRC.ALLOW_VIEW
                ,SRC.ALLOW_DEBIT
                ,SRC.ALLOW_CREDIT
                ,SRC.ALLOW_PEEKBALANCE
				,SRC.FILE_DATE
				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME, 5)
				,'MBK'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT = 1
